body:
PagerDuty: 🔴 SEV0 triggered: Elevated 503s + timeouts (streaming + non-streaming) in eu-west. Impact: hosted-api + dedicated shared pool. Alerts: `gateway_5xx` + `p99_latency` + `stream_disconnect_rate`.

Sean Gallagher: on it. declaring Sev0. @Rafael Mendes can you grab IC? I’ll take comms for now.

Rafael Mendes: yep IC. Starting thread checklist.

Miles Thornton: joining. also FYI incident-bot v2 beta is on for #incidents, should post context cards if we use the button.

Rafael Mendes: /incident start eu-west partial outage

Incident Bot: Incident created: INC-4821 (SEV0)
• Commander: Rafael Mendes
• Channel: #incidents
• Time: 2025-02-28 10:20 PT
Actions: [Post incident context] [Assign roles] [Open timeline]

Rafael Mendes: clicking context.

Incident Bot: Incident Context (v2 beta) for `hosted-api` • region=`eu-west` • window=`last 30m`

[Card: Saturation]
• GPU utilization (p95): 98–100% (threshold 92%)
• Scheduler queue depth: 4.2k (threshold 1.0k)
• Backpressure/admission control: ON (dropping/deferring requests)
• KV cache pressure: 0.93 (threshold 0.85)
• Batch fill: high (continuous batching at max)
Deep links:
• Saturation Overview: https://console.redwoodinference.com/obs/saturation?region=eu-west&service=hosted-api&from=-30m
• Scheduler/Queue: https://console.redwoodinference.com/obs/scheduler?region=eu-west&service=hosted-api&from=-30m

[Card: Recent deploys]
• `scheduler` deployed 18m ago: image `sha: 7c1f2d9` rollout=100% eu-west, canary=PASS (eu-central)
  – PR: https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/29120 (add scheduler saturation metrics)
• `router` deployed 24m ago: image `sha: 3a84b11` rollout=50% eu-west (canary still RUNNING)
  – PR: https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/29104 (export deploy metadata)
Deep links:
• Deploy timeline: https://console.redwoodinference.com/deploys?region=eu-west&service=router&from=-2h

[Card: Config changes (tenant-safe)]
• Routing policy diff detected (redacted): 22m ago
  – `fallback_policy`: changed (details redacted)
  – `capacity_tier`: changed (details redacted)
  – `max_concurrency`: changed (details redacted)
Actions:
• [View redacted diff] • [Request elevated diff access]

[Card: Error budget / SLO]
• 5xx burn rate: 14.2x (15m) / 9.1x (1h)
• p99 latency burn rate: 11.8x (15m)
Deep link:
• Burn dashboard: https://console.redwoodinference.com/slo/burn?service=hosted-api&region=eu-west&window=1h

Aisha Bello: this is 🔥. saturation card already tells us what we’d normally spend 10 min pulling.

Jacob Stein: queue depth 4k and KV pressure 0.93 is bad. looks like hard saturation, not just a 5xx spike.

Logan Wright: checking metric integrity — queue depth is from the new scheduler pipeline, but this looks real (also seeing `admission_deny_rate` jump).

Mina Haddad: recent deploys show router at 50% in eu-west. correlation: spike started ~20m ago per PD?

Rafael Mendes: yeah PD page fired at 10:18 PT, seems aligned.

Connor O'Brien: I can confirm router deploy in eu-west started 10:02 PT, paused once canary flagged slight p99 regression but it continued to 50% (ugh). scheduler deploy finished 10:05.

Sean Gallagher: so likely combo: router change + eu-west already near capacity -> tips into saturation.

Ravi Menon: if admission control is ON and queue is huge, we should degrade: route overflow to us-east, reduce max tokens / disable long-context routes, and turn on more aggressive fallback.

Miles Thornton: bot also has quick actions for standard mitigations in beta. can paste command snippet if folks want.

Rafael Mendes: please.

Incident Bot: Suggested mitigations (based on saturation + 5xx):
1) Enable cross-region spillover (policy `spillover_default`)
2) Tighten request limits (temporarily lower `max_tokens` and streaming concurrency caps)
3) Temporarily disable canary rollout for `router` in eu-west
Links:
• Runbook: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ENGSRE/GPU+saturation+triage
• Routing policy: https://console.redwoodinference.com/platform/routing?region=eu-west

Devon Price: I can execute the bot’s `pause-rollout` action if we agree.

Rafael Mendes: do it. pause router in eu-west at current step.

Devon Price: paused via release controller. will post details.

DeployBot: 🚦 Rollout paused: service=`router` region=`eu-west`
• current: 50% (wave 3/6)
• reason: manual pause by @Devon Price (INC-4821)
• rollback available: yes (previous image `sha: 19bf0aa`)

Mina Haddad: next: spillover. if we move traffic to us-east, watch for auth/session affinity issues on streaming.

Ravi Menon: streaming should be ok; worst case we see disconnects but better than 503s. we can prefer fallback model variant in us-east too.

Sean Gallagher: comms: I’ll post internal update that we’re pausing deploy + enabling spillover; expect partial impact while queues drain.

Rafael Mendes: @Mina Haddad can you flip spillover policy for eu-west -> us-east with caps? @Ravi Menon sanity check the safe settings.

Mina Haddad: on it. going to set `spillover_default=on`, cap at 30% to start.

Ravi Menon: +1, and for long-context routes set stricter admission: `max_tokens=1024` temporarily for eu-west only.

Jacob Stein: we should also lower batching aggressiveness? but that’s more invasive. quickest is reduce load + spillover.

Logan Wright: FYI telemetry query lat is elevated but bot cards still loaded in ~3s. nice.

Aisha Bello: I’ll keep an eye on SLO burn + paging noise; if spillover works we should see 5xx burn drop quickly.

Chloe Martin: any preference for console link time window? current burn link is 1h, I’ll watch 15m too.

Mina Haddad: policy applied.

Mina Haddad: applied:
• eu-west spillover -> us-east at 30% cap
• prioritize “safe” fallback model for overflow
• added temp token cap (eu-west only) per Ravi

Rafael Mendes: thank you. let’s watch metrics 5m.

Incident Bot: Auto-refresh (v2 beta) — Saturation summary (last 5m)
• GPU util p95: 99% -> 94%
• Queue depth: 4.2k -> 2.1k
• Admission denies: 12% -> 6%
• 5xx rate: 5.1% -> 2.2%
Deep link: https://console.redwoodinference.com/obs/saturation?region=eu-west&service=hosted-api&from=-15m

Jacob Stein: queue halving is a good sign. still high but draining.

Aisha Bello: burn rate trending down (15m) but not recovered yet.

Connor O'Brien: do we want to rollback router to previous sha in eu-west? if deploy correlated, safest to rollback.

Mina Haddad: I vote rollback. pause is good but we’re still partially rolled out to the suspect version.

Ravi Menon: agree. rollback router in eu-west, keep spillover until steady.

Rafael Mendes: ok rollback router eu-west. Connor/Devon can you drive? (Connor owns release, Devon has bot access)

Devon Price: initiating rollback.

DeployBot: ⏪ Rollback started: service=`router` region=`eu-west`
• from `sha: 3a84b11` -> to `sha: 19bf0aa`
• waves: 6
• ETA: ~12 min

Sean Gallagher: posting comms update in #eng-announcements + status internal: mitigations in progress, expect recovery soon.

Miles Thornton: note for later: bot’s “recent deploys” card immediately highlighted router at 50% + scheduler at 100%. that would’ve been a big time saver in earlier incidents.

Logan Wright: watching for metric artifacts during rollback; scheduler queue metrics should reflect real drain.

Incident Bot: Auto-refresh — Error signals (last 5m)
• gateway 5xx: 2.2% -> 0.9%
• stream disconnects: 1.8% -> 1.1%
• p99 latency: 7.4s -> 3.2s
Deep links:
• Gateway errors: https://console.redwoodinference.com/obs/errors?service=gateway&region=eu-west&from=-30m
• Streaming health: https://console.redwoodinference.com/obs/streaming?service=hosted-api&region=eu-west&from=-30m

Aisha Bello: 5xx under 1% is much better. p99 still elevated but trending.

Jacob Stein: KV cache pressure dropping too (0.93 -> 0.86). good.

Mina Haddad: spillover is doing work; us-east is handling +22% req/s, still within headroom.

Connor O'Brien: rollback wave 4/6 completed.

DeployBot: ✅ Rollback complete: service=`router` region=`eu-west` now at `sha: 19bf0aa`

Rafael Mendes: great. keep spillover for another 15m while queues normalize, then ramp down.

Sean Gallagher: any customer comms? this is Sev0, external status page update likely.

Rafael Mendes: agree. Sean can you draft? “partial impact in eu-west; mitigations underway; traffic shifted; recovery in progress.”

Sean Gallagher: on it.

Incident Bot: Auto-refresh — Saturation summary (last 5m)
• GPU util p95: 94% -> 88%
• Queue depth: 2.1k -> 540
• Admission denies: 6% -> 1%
• 5xx rate: 0.9% -> 0.2%

Aisha Bello: looks like we’re basically back. burn rate should recover soon.

Rafael Mendes: moving to monitoring. if stable 10m, we can resolve Sev0 and keep an eye on spillover rollback.

Mina Haddad: reducing spillover cap from 30% -> 10% now.

Jacob Stein: no new errors in logs. queue stable sub-600.

Logan Wright: telemetry looks healthy again. also confirming no alert floods.

Rafael Mendes: ok calling incident mitigated. keep spillover 10% for 10m, then off.

Sean Gallagher: status page updated.

Rafael Mendes: resolved. Next steps:
1) Postmortem: why router canary didn’t block rollout + why eu-west headroom so tight.
2) Add automated “deploy correlation” callout to incident template (bot already does it, but we should standardize).
3) Ensure spillover + token cap playbook is documented.

Miles Thornton: I’ll clip the bot v2 context output into the retro doc. also: the auto-refresh summaries were super useful.

Aisha Bello: +1. also alert tuning: we paged after 5xx already high; maybe add earlier saturation alert on queue depth.

Rafael Mendes: assigning owners in follow-up. thanks all.

Incident Bot: Incident INC-4821 marked Resolved by @Rafael Mendes. Timeline export: https://console.redwoodinference.com/incidents/INC-4821/timeline
